# PennyWise

> PennyWise is a free personal daily finance tracker for Malaysia. It helps users manage income, recurring bills and subscriptions, daily expenses, debts, investments, and an emergency backup fund — with a running daily budget and carry-forward overspend logic. All amounts are in Malaysian Ringgit (RM).

## What it does
- Daily budget with carry-forward: set a daily spending limit; overspend carries to the next day so the running balance reflects reality.
- Income tracking with Malaysian statutory deductions: auto-calculates EPF, SOCSO, EIS and accepts PCB tax to store true net take-home pay.
- Recurring deductions and subscriptions: track monthly bills, mark them paid, see what is outstanding.
- Debts: track money you owe and money owed to you; mark settled.
- Investments: trading (buy/sell with quantity and price), unit trust / ASNB (save/redeem/dividend), savings / Tabung Haji (deposit/withdraw/dividend).
- Backup/emergency fund: deposits and withdrawals.
- AI assistant: log entries and ask questions by voice or text; every write is proposed and user-confirmed before saving.

## Who it is for
Individuals in Malaysia who want a simple daily view of personal cash flow in Ringgit (RM).

## Access & privacy
Free to use with an email account. Data is per-user and protected by row-level security; optional two-factor authentication (TOTP) is supported. The app itself is private and requires login; the public marketing page describes the product.

## Key public pages
